_comment: Single source of truth for pipeline paths and the frontend export contract. The frontend agent should edit THIS file (not code) to adapt the contract — see docs/output_contract.md and README 'Frontend integration'.

export._comment: export_transcripts.py reads everything below. All field names and formats are configurable so the ingest side can be matched without code changes.
export._timestamp_note: MM:SS with unbounded minutes (e.g. 75:42 for 1h15m42s). Set to HH:MM:SS to keep pipeline-native.
export._audience_note: Audience/guest section speakers keep their display label ('Audience 1'); only the file-level speaker uses a slug. Flip to true to slugify section speakers too.

speaker_slugs._comment: Valid speaker slugs for the frontend (the app brief mentions 22). Fill in from the app's list; used to validate file-level speakers at export time.
